findings.summary: The retirement gate accepts future measurement periods, so it can authorize M6 before the documented three-week observation window has elapsed.
evidence: Verification: scripts/coordination-retirement-readiness.py:25-33 parses period timestamps and :73-77 checks only seven-day duration; no check binds a period end to measured_at, an externally supplied as-of instant, or the current time.

Verification: tests/coordination-retirement-readiness/run.sh:18-34 constructs periods ending 2026-09-07 and expects PASS while the repository's current date and the report's measured_at are 2026-08-14; the fixture therefore positively encodes premature acceptance rather than a future-period rejection.

Verification: at exact reviewed commit 835b3e719409a409fd169a7bff218c3ac3f5a256, piping a syntactically complete document whose three consecutive periods run 2099-01-01 through 2099-01-22 into `python3 scripts/coordination-retirement-readiness.py /dev/stdin` exits 0 and prints `retirement readiness: PASS`.

Verification: docs/reports/2026-08-14-m6-retirement-readiness.md:32-40 and roadmap lines 275-280 state that 2026-09-07 is the earliest possible end and grants nothing without fresh evidence; a validator that passes 2099 observations on 2026-08-14 does not enforce that fail-closed continuation claim.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at initial review round 0; repair must bind the latest period to a trustworthy as-of boundary, reject future/unelapsed periods, and add a gate-inversion fixture proving premature windows fail.

findings.summary: Every retirement measure and the empty-successor decision remain unauthenticated caller assertions, so arbitrary prose can satisfy the purported evidence gate.
evidence: Verification: scripts/coordination-retirement-readiness.py:56-59 checks only that source_sha looks like 40 lowercase hex characters; it neither resolves the object nor binds measurements to that tree, and the passing fixture at tests/coordination-retirement-readiness/run.sh:29-31 deliberately uses the nonexistent value `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.

Verification: scripts/coordination-retirement-readiness.py:129-133 accepts any non-empty verification string as a reproducible basis; the shipped positive fixture uses only `fixture`, and an adversarial positive run using only `not-a-reproducible-command` exits 0.

Verification: scripts/coordination-retirement-readiness.py:52-156 never reads github_day_census, cycle_id, measured_at, or verdict and does not derive issues_created/issues_closed from raw census entries; changing caller-authored scalar values is sufficient to change the result.

Verification: scripts/coordination-retirement-readiness.py:147-155 trusts an empty same_class_open array without querying or validating the classified issue set, while independent `gh api repos/FS-GG/.github/issues/{2561,2569,2582,2587,2106,2409}` reads on 2026-08-14 returned state=open for all six rows.

Verification: the same adversarial /dev/stdin run that supplied a fake SHA, arbitrary verification prose, invented issue counts, and same_class_open=[] printed PASS, demonstrating a reachable false retirement authorization rather than a hypothetical schema concern.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at initial review round 0; repair must validate structured authoritative observations (including a resolvable source and complete issue/successor censuses) or explicitly separate schema lint from an independently enforced live-evidence acceptance gate, with mutation tests that arbitrary strings and empty caller lists cannot satisfy.

findings.summary: The policy/check/workflow trend can pass across discontinuous snapshots, so the validator does not establish that those inventories actually declined through the three periods.
evidence: Verification: scripts/coordination-retirement-readiness.py:115-118 checks only each row's local end is not greater than its start, while :140-145 compares only the sum of the first starts with the sum of the final ends; it never requires period N end to equal period N+1 start for any inventory.

Verification: at exact reviewed commit, an adversarial document with each inventory moving 10->9 in week 1, resetting to 100->99 in week 2, then resetting to 8->7 in week 3 exits 0 and prints PASS; the period timestamps themselves remain consecutive.

Verification: roadmap lines 570-580 require the number of independent policy implementations, check scripts, and workflows to trend down; accepting an unaccounted 9->100 jump between adjacent periods makes that health measure false even though the validator reports success.

Verification: tests/coordination-retirement-readiness/run.sh:36-48 mutates timestamp gaps but contains no inventory-boundary continuity mutation, so the false-pass path is not covered by the focused suite.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at initial review round 0; repair must enforce per-metric snapshot continuity (or derive period deltas from content-addressed inventories) and add a discontinuous-reset negative fixture.

findings.summary: The consolidated policy workflow is not triggered by retirement evidence changes, so the file that will eventually request M6 authorization can change without running its validator subject.
evidence: Verification: .github/workflows/policy.yml:3-36 includes the validator implementation and fixture paths in both filtered triggers but omits docs/reports/evidence/** and the M6 readiness report/roadmap paths.

Verification: policy/subjects.json:21-24 registers only `bash tests/coordination-retirement-readiness/run.sh`; tests/coordination-retirement-readiness/run.sh:7-13 reads the committed M6 evidence file, so that evidence file is an executable dependency of the declared subject.

Verification: tests/policy-runner/run.sh:22-30 checks workflow coverage for scripts/coordination-retirement-readiness.py and tests/coordination-retirement-readiness/** but omits docs/reports/evidence/2026-08-14-m6-retirement-readiness.json; consequently `bash tests/policy-runner/run.sh` passes despite the missing trigger dependency.

Verification: the base-to-head diff adds docs/reports/evidence/2026-08-14-m6-retirement-readiness.json as the machine-readable retirement census, and docs/reports/2026-08-14-m6-retirement-readiness.md:7-15 instructs operators to run the validator against it; a PR changing only that input does not match policy.yml's pull_request paths.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unresolved at initial review round 0; repair must add the authoritative retirement evidence path(s) to both workflow triggers and extend trigger-coverage regression checks so an omitted evidence dependency fails.
